## Match

A game in progress. Every copy of every part is tracked (zone, order, face, counters), moves go in a log you can undo, and the dice are seeded so a match can be replayed.

Seats are people or AI opponents. Opponents are data too (see *Opponent*), so most play without calling a language model.
attributes.cardDescription: One sitting of a game: every card, die and chip tracked copy by copy, a full history with undo, and AI opponents taking their turns.
